resources.string: It is a one-time payment (not a subscription): you pay once and what you buy is yours for good.
Pick what to buy: a single product from the table below, or \"Buy ALL\" to unlock all %1$s customizations at once.
Tap the product button: the Ko-fi shop opens in your browser.
Pay there with whichever method Ko-fi offers you.
Use the same email as your Google account, or note down the one you use for the next step.
Come back to the app and tap \"Restore purchases\": it unlocks instantly.
Each row is a product (pack) in the Ko-fi shop. The check shows whether you already have it.
